subject: Synthesis: final OKR judgement memo & publish plan
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_m@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: 2027-03-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Synthesis: final OKR judgement memo & publish plan

Team —

Quick note to lock the final artifacts for EOQ OKR judgement and the QBR packet. I reviewed the draft annotations from the functional leads and pulled together a short stitch of what remains disputed vs. what is ready to publish. Need a rapid pass from each of you on the two outstanding items below so we can: (1) publish the OKR ledger to the leadership folder, (2) produce a 1-page exec brief for the QBR slide pack, and (3) confirm the public-facing OKR blurb for the Town Hall.

Outstanding items (decision asks):
- A2 (Serving runtime adoption): LAURA — confirm whether we hold at "Mostly Met (6)" or bump to "Met (7)" given the last two customer rollouts; attached annotate shows the edge-case rollout that went to dedicated. I need your final judgement and 2-line rationale.
- C3 (Cost per token improvement): VIVEK — we have split signals (batching improvements + one regression in mid-Jan). The recommendation in the sheet is to call it "Partially Met (4)" with an action remediation plan for Q1->Q2. Do you accept?

Logistics: if I have your replies by EOD today (PST) I will: (a) merge the annotated evidence into okr-annotated-evidence.zip, (b) write the 1-page exec brief and circulate for sign-off, and (c) prepare the Town Hall blurb for Monday.

Attachments: [Attachment: score-annotations.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)]

Thanks — brief replies please.

— Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Head of GTM Programs, Redwood Inference
——
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_m@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: 2027-03-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Synthesis: final OKR judgement memo & publish plan

Rafael —

Thanks for the stitch. Short answer: I keep A2 at Met (7). Rationale in two lines:
- The two recent customer rollouts adopted the optimized runtime path with no perf regressions and reduced 99th percentile latency by ~8% (see embed in sheet, rows 14-18).
- The edge-case you flagged was a pre-rollout configuration that we patched; it does not change the production-level objective attainment.

I'll add a 1-paragraph justification in the "score-annotations.xlsx" in the A2 tab with the exact metrics (IANA: referencing Drive link below).

Attachment: [Attachment: okr-evidence-A2.pdf (PDF, 320KB)]

— Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Product Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_m@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: 2027-03-21T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Synthesis: final OKR judgement memo & publish plan

Rafael / team —

On C3: I accept the recommendation to mark as Partially Met (4). Two quick notes to include in the remediation plan: (1) prioritize request-level KV caching changes for high-throughput endpoints (Jan regression was a side effect of an aggressive cache invalidation change), (2) add a Q2 spike to evaluate 4-bit quantization on a low-risk model class which could recover ~1.5-2% token cost.

I uploaded a short remediation tracker and flagged owners. See attachment.

Attachment: [Attachment: c3-remediation-tracker.csv (CSV, 18KB)]

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
SVP, Engineering, Redwood Inference

Adding a small editorial ask on the Town Hall blurb: please avoid percentages in the high-level slide (ops and infra wording only). Proposed line: "We completed major serving runtime migrations and reduced tail latency on key customer flows; continued work on cost optimizations will roll into Q2."

I also ran a final pass on the exec brief draft (see link). Two tiny edits: shorten the "lessons" section to two bullets and add a single line on A/B evaluation cadence.

Subject: Finalized: judgement, artifacts merged, and next steps (publishing + town hall)

Thanks all — final update and publish plan. I consolidated inputs and performed the minimal editorial edits Marissa suggested. Outcomes below (final for record):

- A2 (Serving runtime adoption): Met (7). Laura rationale included and attached (okr-evidence-A2.pdf).
- C3 (Cost per token improvement): Partially Met (4). Vivek remediation plan accepted and owners assigned.

Artifacts attached and published to the leadership folder: okr-annotated-evidence.zip (contains score-annotations.xlsx, okr-evidence-A2.pdf, c3-remediation-tracker.csv, exec-brief.md). I also copied the one-page exec brief into the QBR slide pack (internal link above).

Publish actions completed:
- Ledger published: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-OKR-EVIDENCE
- Town Hall blurb submitted to comms (Marissa) — suggested line implemented.
- I prepared a short "remediation watchlist" for the ops weekly (owners and due dates included).

Attachments: [Attachment: okr-annotated-evidence.zip (ZIP, 2.1MB)]

If there are no objections by EOD Wednesday I will mark the EOQ ledger as final and send to Board Secretariat for the executive packet.

— Rafael
